cards.statement: The Calvin cycle needs light directly.
cards.explanation: It is light-independent and can run in the dark as long as ATP and NADPH are available.
cards.source: The Calvin cycle is light-independent and can run in darkness.

cards.question: How many carbon dioxide molecules make one glucose?
cards.explanation: Six turns of the cycle fix six CO2 into one glucose.
cards.source: Six molecules of carbon dioxide are needed to make one glucose molecule.

cards.back: Captures carbon dioxide in the first step of the Calvin cycle.
